children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Model versions, configuration, storage, networking, probes, and files so the operator renders a safe server deterministically.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Every generated file needs a deterministic path, format, owner, validation rule, and restart expectation.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Define branding, category, architecture support, image mapping, and compatible version/loader choices without mutable ambiguity.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Pin image and version transforms explicitly.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Never make latest the only reproducible option.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Describe compatibility so the UI filters impossible combinations.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Map typed inputs to env, args, or files without exposing secrets. Ship locales/<tag>.json translations (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Declare defaults, validation, secrets, advanced flags, and auto-computation.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Give each file deterministic path, format, and ownership.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Document which changes require restart and which are live.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Align ports, resources, security, probes, volumes, backups, files, mods, logs, RCON, and graceful stop around the same paths.

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
